channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Frank Ntilikina | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Frank Ntilikina from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Christian Wood, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Cuban:

“I think Christian (Wood) and Frank (Ntilikina) both. In particular, what Frank did defensively (in the postseason) while being sick and banged up was insane.”

Mark Cuban on Christian Wood, Frank Ntilikina, Aug 20, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina tonight:

“He was a bulldog. We had a talk about two weeks ago and he said, ‘Coach, I’ve been through a lot in my two years and I felt like I finally understand what the NBA is about and I know I haven’t shown it yet but I’m a dog too.’”

David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina, Nov 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Mike Vorkunov:David Fizdale on the Frank Ntilikina DNP:

“Coach's decision... None of them are ever in the dungeon... I will come back to him.”

David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina:

“He just keeps giving me multiple things.... he’s going to fill out his role as we play more games and I’m just going to let him tell me what that is. I’m just going to keep putting him out there and letting him play free.”

David Fizdale on Frank Ntilikina, Oct 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Jeff Hornacek on Frank Ntilikina:

“I don’t worry about guys like Frank. Frank wants to get good. He’s always asking questions. He’s always watching tape, and we know he’s going to work extremely hard this summer to take another step…. He’s going to have a great career.”

Jeff Hornacek on Frank Ntilikina, Apr 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Ian Begley:Jeff Hornacek on Frank Ntilikina starting at some point this season:

“It could be down the line. We don't know. We'll see what happens in the next week or so. We have four more games before the All-Star break. We'll continue to monitor that.”

Jeff Hornacek on Frank Ntilikina, Feb 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Trey Burke, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
“We do have another option. So on a night Frank (Ntilikina) is not having a great night or something, we have Trey (Burke) for that opportunity,”

Jeff Hornacek on Trey Burke, Frank Ntilikina, Jan 20, 2018. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Dennis Smith Jr. on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Dennis Smith Jr. on fellow rookie PG Frank Ntilikina:

“He's a really good defender. He found his niche early in the league. It ain't nothing but respect on my end for him.”

Dennis Smith Jr. on Frank Ntilikina, Jan 8, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tony Parker on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Marc Berman:Tony Parker on Ntilikina:

“I think he's got the right stuff. I don't know if New York will be patient.”

Tony Parker on Frank Ntilikina, Dec 28, 2017. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Berman.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jeff Hornacek, Kristaps Porzingis, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
“I think Phil did some good things here. Drafting [Kristaps] Porzingis and hiring Jeff Hornacek. I think [Frank] Ntilikina looks like a good player. It feels like they’re on a good path right now.”

Steve Kerr on Jeff Hornacek, Kristaps Porzingis, Frank Ntilikina, Nov 22, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
#JazzDonovan Mitchell on #Knicks friend Frank Ntilikina:

“He's a real cool dude. I was really impressed with the way he handled the situation against the Cavs.”

Donovan Mitchell on Frank Ntilikina, Nov 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKerber.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on LeBron James, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Enes Kanter on his war of words with LeBron James and defending Knicks guard Frank Ntilikina:

“I’ll die for my teammates. Whatever happens, I’ll always have my teammates back because I see this team and this organization like my family.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on LeBron James, Frank Ntilikina, Nov 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: LeBron James on Frank Ntilikina, Dennis Smith
item.description:
Ian Begley‏:LeBron James:

“I wasn’t even thinking about (Frank Ntilikina) when I was talking about Dennis Smith. I was thinking about just the Knicks organization & Phil Jackson at the time & Dennis Smith’s talent & (his fit with Kristaps) Porzingis & that’s all I was thinking about.”

LeBron James on Frank Ntilikina, Dennis Smith, Nov 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Dennis Smith, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
Mark Cuban on why Mavs preferred Dennis Smith Jr. over Frank Ntilikina, who Knicks took with the previous pick:

“We just think Dennis is more ready right now. I think Frank is going to be a great player, but we didn't think he was ready to come in and be an impact player day one. We thought Dennis is.”

Mark Cuban on Dennis Smith, Frank Ntilikina, Jul 9, 2017. Source: ESPN.
